topic: 外国友人想了解中国传统节日，写信推荐一个节日并说明理由
essay:
Dear Tom,

    I am delighted to hear that you are interested in Chinese traditional festivals. I would like to recommend the Spring Festival, which is the most important celebration in China.

    The Spring Festival, also known as Chinese New Year, usually falls in January or February. During this festival, families reunite for a grand dinner on New Year's Eve, enjoying traditional dishes such as dumplings and spring rolls. People also set off fireworks, hang red lanterns, and exchange red envelopes as symbols of good luck. Additionally, various folk activities, including dragon dances and temple fairs, make the festival even more vibrant.

    I believe experiencing the Spring Festival would give you a profound understanding of Chinese culture. I look forward to your visit.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

Dear Tom,

    I'm writing to recommend a Chinese traditional festival to you. I think the Mid-Autumn Festival is a good choice.

    The Mid-Autumn Festival is celebrated on August 15th of the lunar calendar. On this day, families get together and eat mooncakes. People also enjoy watching the full moon at night. The festival has a history of more than 2,000 years and it represents family reunion.

    I hope you can come to China and experience this festival. You will love it. Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

topic: 邀请外国朋友参加学校举办的中国文化节活动
essay:
Dear Jack,

    I am writing to invite you to attend the Chinese Culture Festival, which will be held in our university next Saturday.

    The festival is designed to showcase the richness and diversity of Chinese culture. A wide range of activities will be available, including calligraphy workshops, traditional music performances, and a tea ceremony demonstration. Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to taste authentic Chinese cuisine from different regions. The event will run from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. at the Student Activity Center.

    I believe this would be an excellent opportunity for you to deepen your understanding of Chinese culture. I sincerely hope you can join us.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

topic: 以学生会名义写一份倡议书，呼吁全校师生开展“光盘行动”，杜绝食堂餐饮浪费
essay:
A Proposal on Cherishing Food

Dear Teachers and Students,

    Recently, the problem of food waste in our campus canteens has attracted wide concern. In order to promote a sustainable lifestyle, we are launching the "Clean Plate Campaign" and appeal to everyone to take action.

    To achieve this goal, we suggest taking the following measures. First, please order food reasonably according to your appetite instead of ordering excessively. Second, cultivate the habit of finishing all the food on your plate. Third, if there is leftover food, take it away rather than throwing it into trash bins.

    Every grain of rice comes from hard work. Let us start today and say no to food waste!

Postgraduate Student Union
October 7, 2026
